channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran sends ‘mixed’ messages as Pakistani mediators depart Tehran
item.description: Pakistan’s army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, has reportedly departed Iran after holding multiple meetings.

item.title: Overnight Israeli strikes on Gaza leave behind heavy destruction
item.description: Overnight Israeli strikes devastated the Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camps in central Gaza despite an ongoing ceasefire.

item.title: US Secretary of State kicks off India visit, invites Modi to White House
item.description: US-Israel war with Iran among issues looming large as Rubio expected to seek to mend in ties with New Delhi.

item.title: Five police officers, 13 year-old boy killed in Israeli attack on Gaza
item.description: Attack on a police post in northern Gaza comes as dozens of people were wounded in Israeli attacks in the past 48 hours.

item.title: Israeli air strike pounds southern Lebanon leaving many injured
item.description: An Israeli air strike has hit the Al-Baqbouq area north of Tyre in southern Lebanon.

item.title: China coal mine blast kills at least 90, leaves nine missing
item.description: A gas explosion at the Liushenyu coal mine in China’s Shanxi province has killed at least 90 workers.

item.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
item.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

item.title: Rubio meets Modi during India visit with energy high on agenda
item.description: The secretary of state wants to sell US energy to Delhi to make up for shortfalls caused by the Iran war.

item.title: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
item.description: The detainees say they were slapped, hit, humiliated and even subjected to sexual violence, but Israel's prison service says the allegations are false.

item.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran publishes a map claiming "armed forces oversight" across more than 22,000 sq km of the waterway.
